lines.text: Ryan Holiday is the bestselling author of Trust Me, I’m Lying; The Obstacle Is the Way;…
******** at The Painted Porch Book Shop
#1 NYT Bestselling Author Stoic Virtues Series out now @dailystoic @dailydad @dailystoicpodcast @paintedporchbookshop Sign up for my daily newsletter

This fall, join me for my @dailystoic Live speaking tour across the world. We’ll talk Stoicism and the practical ways you can apply it to the challenges you face day to day. I’ll even take your questions directly from stage. Tickets are going fast—get yours at dailystoiclive.com or via the link in bio and grab one of the remaining VIP packages if you’d like to meet me before the show. I’ll see you out there.

I’ve written a lot of books. But this series — Courage is Calling, Discipline is Destiny, Right Thing, Right Now, and Wisdom Takes Work — is the one I’m most proud of. The one I believe matters most. These books exist because I needed them. I needed to sit with these ideas, trace them back through history, find the people who actually lived them under pressure, and figure out what they meant for my own life. The signed boxed set is available now at dailystoic.com/virtuesboxset or via the link in bio.

Australia & New Zealand — I’m coming back. This October, I’ll be returning for a 5-city tour to talk about Stoicism, discipline, leadership, and the lessons that have helped so many people around the world live a better life. Whether you’ve read the books or listened to the podcast daily, I’d love to see you there to discuss these ideas in person. Sign up now for early access to tickets at dailystoiclive.com before they go on sale.
Today is the last day to register to vote. Head to www.vote.org to register/check your status.
“Only that which is written down has a chance to last” Watch the full episode with @author.richcohen & @ryanholiday on the @dailystoic YouTube channel
The Daily Stoic 10th Anniversary Edition comes out October 6th. The first 5,000 copies are signed and numbered and are only available at dailystoic.com/ds10
Somebody should write a book about that

Today’s guest: Rich Cohen - bestselling author, journalist, and screenwriter @author.richcohen and @ryanholiday trade stories about the books and writers that shaped them, the ambition behind creative work, how discarded material influences a finished book, the myths that can take over a writer’s life, and more. Watch the episode now on YouTube or Apple Podcasts

10 years in the making. The Daily Stoic 10th Anniversary Edition just showed up, with new quotes, a new intro, profiles of Seneca and Zeno, and a decade of fixes. The first 5,000 copies are signed and only available at dailystoic.com/ds10

My September reading list. Each month, I send one email with 5 to 10 amazing books that I read, reviewed and think you’ll like. The email is simple and quick and that’s why its grown to reach 300,000+ readers since 2008. Sign up for free at: Ryanholiday.com/reading-list
